entities.name: Lizard
entities.description: A creature type for land-based reptiles with limbs and external ears, including sentient lizard folk such as the viashino.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: A humanoid lizard race found on Dominaria, Ravnica, Capenna and other planes.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: A lizardfolk who assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A character on a quest to stop the Calamity Beasts, assisted by Gev.

entities.name: Jasper Flint
entities.description: A canon lizard now on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: The being thought to have created the Dominarian viashino.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A figure said by some to have transformed humans into the leapers of Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Beasts Mabel and Gev work to stop.

entities.name: Ever-Burning Oak
entities.description: A tree Bloomburrow lizardfolk worship, from whose center young lizardfolk collect an ember.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A plane where lizardfolk are one of the native animalfolk.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The location of the main viashino civilization on Dominaria.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A family of Capenna among whom the draconic viashino are found.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that has used lizards in many experiments.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A guild whose devkarin keep monitor lizards as pack animals.

entities.name: Rootwallas
entities.description: Orange lizards with blue heads and legs, encountered in Dominaria after the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Lagac
entities.description: A large lizard species of Zendikar that withstood the Eldrazi invasion.

events.summary: Bloomburrow lizardfolk, not originally native to the Valley, populate its shaley hills and ravines many seasons before the Omenpath Era.
events.quote: lizardfolk populated Valley's few shaley hills and rocky ravines

events.summary: Gev assists Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.
events.quote: assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts

events.summary: Rootwallas are encountered in Dominaria during the Mirari crisis and the Second Phyrexian Invasion following the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: rootwallas were encountered in Dominaria during the Mirari crisis
